READY FOR AUDIT (operator 116) — growth-project-mobile#360 @ 4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf

Piece W2 of the Health Connect split of #317 (6 pieces: #359 -> #360 -> #361 -> #362 -> #363 -> #364). Base `agent115/wear-split-1-ingest-foundation`. T4 (max-tier rule).
Checks at this head (latest run per check, 1 checks): all green. CodeQL, danger, banned casts and build-sbom run only when the stack lands on main.
Land rule: Land as one (rule 11); ships in the clinic binary on day 1 (owner 10-03 18:42) with the backend flag flip FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST.

SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator 116, MODEL_ROUTING 8.2) — growth-project-mobile#360 @ 4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf
- Lines: 2647 changed (source 1243 / tests 1404 / migrations 0 / docs 0; excluded 0); 24 files. Under the 3,000 hard limit.
- Seams (largest areas): `src/services/health` 2283, `src/hooks/useHealthConnectSync.test.tsx` 144, `src/hooks/__tests__` 95, `src/hooks/useHealthConnectSync.ts` 74, `src/hooks/useHealthKitSync.ts` 51.
- Coupling: code piece with its own tests; the piece boundaries, dependency direction (no piece imports a later piece) and per-piece tests are stated in the PR body.
- Decision: KEEP. This is already one logical piece of the owner-ordered split of #317. Cutting it further would separate code from the tests that prove it, and would add a restack round to every later piece without making any line easier to audit. Fix rounds must keep it under 3,000.

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-mobile#360 @ 4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf — VERDICT: APPROVE

A/B/C = 0/0/2

Job AUD-OPUS-W12-116 (operator 116 wave). Tier T4 (health data; max-tier rule). This is split piece H2 of #317 @ `d0407b62`. Read-only: no push, merge, dispatch, build or production action.

### Prior findings
- **This lens on #317:** all findings are closed. The approval chain and the C-317-6 operator gate are as in the #359 verdict.
- **Sol on #317:** B-317-12 is in #364's file, so it does not apply here.
- No finding is open on #360.

### Byte-identity to #317, and evidence reuse (G09)
- **Base:** #359 head `e0f3d2a7`. The piece has one commit, `4a508d8`.
- **24 files, +1678/−969:**
  - 20 modified files: the blob at 4a508d8 equals the blob at d0407b62.
  - 4 deleted files are absent at d0407b62 too: `src/hooks/useHealthKitSync.ts`, `src/hooks/useHealthConnectSync.ts` and their two suites.
- **Base content:** #359 touches none of the 24 files, so their base is main's. The piece diff therefore equals #317's diff for these files, byte for byte. There are no split edits.
- **Reuse decision:** the piece rests on this lens's T4 chain on #317. No line changed after the last APPROVE, and the piece contains no code this lens never approved. The whole diff was re-read for the boundary and privacy checks below.

### Piece boundary
- **One reachable seam.** At this head the only app-reachable changed code is the call to `connectOnDeviceProvider(target)` (default `ALWAYS_CURRENT`) from main's `ConnectProviderSheet.tsx:138`.
  - The sync services, ingest API, progress store and fence are reached only from tests (`git grep` of non-test importers).
- **Deleted hooks.** They had no app importer on main, only their own suites, which are deleted with them (449 suites = 451 − 2).
- **Lazy native load is kept.**
  - `onDeviceConnect` now imports `healthConnectClient` for `buildReadPermissions`.
  - That module requires `react-native-health-connect` only inside `loadHealthConnectLib` (`healthConnectClient.ts:78-83`), behind `assertSupported`.
  - The build-guard suite still asserts that an OFF build performs no native evaluation and no post.
- **Behaviour if this tree shipped alone (not a finding):**
  - **Android:** main's config keeps Health Connect off in every profile, so the call returns `'disabled'` before any changed code runs.
  - **iOS:** the old sheet's `switch (outcome)` (`:140`) has no case for `'error'`, `'update_required'` or `'stopped'`. A HealthKit permission-screen failure would therefore be silent if this tree alone were built or OTA-published. H4 (#362) brings the updated sheet.
  - **Consequence:** rule 11 "land as one" is mandatory for this stack. No build or OTA may come from main between pieces.
- **Samsung guard case.** The Samsung case of `healthConnectBuildGuard.test.ts` is removed here, while `samsungHealth/*` stays until #364.
  - `samsungHealth` has no app importer: only its own suites and the unimported `useSamsungHealthSync` hook use it.
  - Its client still calls `assertAndroidHealthConnectEnabled`.
  - The coverage gap is on unreachable code that #364 deletes.
- **CI:**
  - Typecheck, lint, test is green ([run 37156241700](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37156241700/job/111300091368)): tsc, eslint, and jest with 449 suites / 6,342 tests.
  - Analyze and CodeQL do not run on this PR (`codeql.yml` `pull_request: branches: [main]`). The same bytes passed Analyze (javascript-typescript), Analyze (actions) and CodeQL at #317 d0407b62 ([run 37143998466](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37143998466)), and they run again when #359 carries the landed tree into main.

### Health-data privacy
- **Logs:** `healthConnectSyncService.ts:177,228,248` log counts, record-type names and a native error message.
  - `logger` writes to the console in `__DEV__` builds only (`src/utils/logger.ts`).
  - Sentry drops console breadcrumbs and request bodies (`sentryPrivacy`).
  - The piece has no health values in logs, and no PostHog or Sentry call.
- **Fence:**
  - It is type-required in both services (`HealthKitSyncOptions.fence` at `:128`, `HealthConnectSyncDeps.fence` at `:78`), and `fence.userId` must equal `scope.userId` (`:197`, `:162`).
  - `assertCurrent` runs before the reads, before every request and before the progress save.
  - `throwIfStopped` runs before every native call and every Health Connect page.
  - A stop ends the whole run and is never counted as a per-type failure.
- **No `userId` in the body:** it is removed from both normalizers and from `NormalizedSample`, and the wire format is the allow-listed `toIngestWire`.

### SIZE ASSESSMENT (operator, 19:26): agree with KEEP
- **Counts verified:** 2,647 = source 1,243 + tests 1,404, over 24 files.
  - Non-test source is +760/−483, so additions are under the ~800 target.
  - 125 of the deleted lines are the two dead hooks.
- **KEEP fits 8.2's own criterion:** the audits converged. The content is byte-identical to the dual-reviewed #317, whose only open finding was a test pin carried by #364.
- **Further cut:** a HealthKit / Health Connect cut is possible (`onDeviceConnect` and the build guard tie the two). It would add a restack to four pieces for no gain in auditability.
- **Nit:** the "Seams" line lists directories rather than logical seams. Later assessments should name each candidate cut and say why it was rejected.

### C-360-1: late-arriving samples older than the re-read overlap are never read
- **Where:**
  - `healthConnectSyncService.ts:65,114-119`: a 5-minute overlap per record type.
  - `healthKitSyncService.ts:82,166-174`: a 60-minute overlap.
  - Workouts use the same window (`healthKitClient.ts:390`). Only sleep gets the 36 h look-back (`:226,359`).
- **Counterexample, Health Connect:**
  1. TGP opens at 07:15, so the SleepSession progress is 07:15.
  2. A watch app writes the 23:00–07:00 session to Health Connect at 07:30.
  3. The next open, at 12:00, reads [07:10, 12:00]. The night lies wholly before that range and is never read.
  - The same happens to steps and heart rate that Samsung Health, Fitbit, Garmin or Oura write to Health Connect in batches.
- **Counterexample, HealthKit:** a watch workout from 09:00 to 10:00 reaches the phone at 13:00, after a 12:00 open. The next open reads from 11:00, so the workout is skipped.
- **Cumulative buckets:** an hourly steps or active-energy bucket posted before a late contribution arrives keeps its first value, because the backend keeps the first copy of a dedup key. Widening the overlap alone does not fix these.
- **Fix rule:**
  - Widen the per-type re-read to a look-back, for example 36 h as for HealthKit sleep. Re-posts are deduplicated by `sourceRecordId` and stable bounds.
  - Or use Health Connect's changes token.
  - Post cumulative buckets only after a settle delay (for example, end at or before now − 2 h), or have the backend replace cumulative buckets on the same dedup key.
  - **Test:** progress at T; a record that ends before T − overlap and is written after T is read on the next run.
- **Recommendation:** a follow-up PR after the stack lands, before the clinic Android build, and a late-write case in the device pass.

### C-360-2: an import pass is all-or-nothing
- **Where:** `healthKitSyncService.ts:215,242,261` reads the whole window, posts every batch, and saves progress only at the end. `healthConnectSyncService.ts:240-245` does the same; its reads are bounded at `MAX_READ_PAGES` = 20 per type.
- **Counterexample:**
  - An Apple Watch wearer with about 25,000 samples over 30 days needs about 100 requests at 250 samples each.
  - The backend allows 60 requests a minute (`WEARABLES_INGEST_PER_MIN`), so the pass takes 2–3 minutes including Retry-After waits.
  - Backgrounding the app, or one non-429 failure, in that time discards the pass. The next open starts the 30 days again.
  - Dedup keeps the data correct, but the import may never finish for someone who does not stay on the screen.
- **Fix rule:** read HealthKit oldest-first in day-sized windows, and save progress per window once its batches land, with the same fence checks.
- **Test:** a failure on batch k keeps the progress of the windows before k.

Both C findings are design improvements. Neither makes this piece unsafe.

### Landing
Land as one with #359 and #361 to #364 (rule 11), then the backend flag flip `FEATURE_WEARABLES_INGEST_POST`.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#360 @ 4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/0

Independent T4 audit, AUD-SOL-W12-116; one newly executed health-data logger-boundary counterexample prevents approval, notwithstanding the green required test job and the accepted original's byte identity. ([Exact H2 candidate](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf), [independent executed probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))

### Prior findings and explicit G09 applicability decision

- This lens's original #317 approval was `82137c312e957cb05eedeaebf86fcd95029f2bde`; its subsequent `d0407b62` request-changes was only B-317-12, two H6 `easUpdateGuard` expectations, not a finding against H1/H2. ([Own accepted original](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317#issuecomment-5972055787), [own latest original verdict](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317#issuecomment-5972176395))
- Independently verified: all 20 surviving changed blobs equal both original heads, all 4 deleted hook/test files are absent at both original heads, and H1 changes none of these 24 paths; the entire 3,697-line piece diff was read and no split-only source edit was found. ([H2 tree](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf), [approved original tree](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/82137c312e957cb05eedeaebf86fcd95029f2bde))
- **Reuse: PARTIAL** — prior evidence remains applicable to the identical scoped progress, normalization, pagination, request fencing and native-attempt fixes, but **not** to an absolute no-health-text-in-logs conclusion, because the new actual-service probe below contradicts it; this is an inherited missed boundary, not a claimed split regression and not a reopening of the repaired shell classifier. ([Own prior logger closure scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317#issuecomment-5972055787), [new contradictory execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))

### B-360-1 — Must fix: Health Connect read failures log arbitrary native health text, including after sign-out starts

**Location:** `src/services/health/healthConnect/healthConnectSyncService.ts:218-232`, especially `:221` and `:231`; the successful-read branch checks the fence after the native await, but the rejection branch checks only the error's class and forwards `err.message` / `String(err)` to `logger.error`. ([Exact error catch](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf/src%2Fservices%2Fhealth%2FhealthConnect%2FhealthConnectSyncService.ts))

**Executed counterexample:** a test-only branch from exact `4a508d8b` adds one three-case spec and the prescribed one-job lane, without modifying production code; it uses the real sync service, real paged-client wrapper, real session fence and a synthetic native rejection containing `AUDIT_360_PRIVATE_WEIGHT_81_6_KG`. ([Probe run at audit commit `7e3c9a9360440ae64a15239bec17fcb3280817f4`](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201))

1. With a current session, the native read fails normally and the logger receives that exact arbitrary health-text marker in its `error` field, so the no-health-text assertion fails. ([Executed first failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))
2. If `stopOnDeviceHealthWork()` runs while that same native page is in flight and the page then rejects, the same sensitive text is logged **after the synchronous sign-out fence has retired the run**; upload and progress correctly stay empty, but the silent-stale-error assertion fails. ([Executed second failure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))
3. The unchanged-session successful empty-read control completes and passes; the job result is **2 failed / 1 passed**, not an infrastructure/type/setup failure. ([Probe assertions and result](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))

**Impact and limit:** this proves a logger-argument privacy failure and stale-session logging, not a physical-device leak or production Sentry/analytics transport; the current logger only forwards console calls in `__DEV__`, which does not make forwarding free-form health/native text acceptable at this boundary. ([Executed logger-boundary evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877), [same lens's earlier logger-boundary standard](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317#issuecomment-5972055787))

**Minimal fix rule:** re-check the stop/session fence in the catch before any error processing or logging, and emit only a closed allow-listed error class/code plus the existing structural record type / resumed bit; do not interpolate message, mutable name, arbitrary rejection, raw SDK code or sample data, and preserve partial-read retry/progress behavior. ([Affected production boundary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf/src%2Fservices%2Fhealth%2FhealthConnect%2FhealthConnectSyncService.ts))

**Verification:** keep the saved probe cases as regression tests, add arbitrary non-Error rejection plus account-switch/cancel-after-rejected-page cases, demonstrate those privacy cases pass after the fix, and retain the existing current-session/failed-type/page-resume controls; the run above supplies the failing-before evidence. ([Existing failing-before execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))

### Piece boundary, privacy checks and CI

- The deleted HealthKit/Health Connect hooks had no app importers; the new sync services, ingest and progress/fence path have no app caller until the later orchestration/screen pieces, while the existing sheet already reaches the modified permission helper. ([H2 source tree](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf))
- **Land as one is mandatory**: the older iOS sheet does not handle the helper's newly returned `error` outcome and does not pass an attempt check; Android stays build-metadata gated with lazy native loading until H6, so do not build, deploy or OTA-publish an intermediate H2 tree. ([H2 source and configuration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf), [operator whole-stack landing instruction](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/360#issuecomment-5975773333))
- Session/scope mismatch rejects before reading, stopped successful reads are discarded, every ingest batch re-checks the fence, progress is account/connection scoped and saved only after posting, native grants are not auto-requested by Health Connect refresh, and wire samples omit `userId`; none of those retained controls fixes the separate rejected-page logger path above. ([Reviewed H2 implementation/tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf), [independent rejection-path proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))
- **Typecheck, lint, test: SUCCESS** at exact PR head, with eslint, `tsc --noEmit` and **449 suites / 6,342 tests passing**; that existing suite lacks the two adversarial logger assertions demonstrated by the separate failing probe. ([Required PR-head CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37156241700/job/111300091368), [added targeted probe](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))
- Both Analyze checks are main-base-only and did not run for this stacked H2 base, so integrated/main-based Analyze results remain a landing prerequisite rather than an invented green H2 check. ([Recorded stacked base/applicability](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/360#issuecomment-5975773333))

### SIZE ASSESSMENT disposition

Verified +1678/-969 = **2,647 changed lines**, source **+760/-483 = 1,243** and tests **+918/-486 = 1,404**, with no migrations/docs/lock/snapshot exclusion; **KEEP** remains reasonable for the paired platform-sync/normalization contract with its own tests, and the bounded logger repair must stay below 3,000. ([Exact H2 diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/commit/4a508d8bc01c2fa080fd120cbe02c7824ce06cdf), [19:26 operator assessment](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/360#issuecomment-5975773333))

Repair B-360-1 in H2, restack merge-only under the wearables stack lock, and request fresh dual exact-head audits; no candidate branch, build, merge or production action was performed by this lens. ([Finding's executed evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877))

FIX ROUND 1 (B-W2-117, agent 117) — growth-project-mobile#360 @ fde1875edc1bd5d14ac8fda4f2e68ee8b7c5ebf5

Builder job B-W2-117 (Claude Opus 5.5), T4 (health data). The fix was written by B-W2-116 before the owner's 21:04 PDT pause and saved on `wip/op116/B-W2-116-360`; this round verified it line by line and pushed it as a fast-forward (`4a508d8b..fde1875`, no force, no rebase). Content changes are only in this piece.

### Open findings at 4a508d8b
- Sol REQUEST CHANGES 0/1/0 ([issuecomment-5976328100](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/360#issuecomment-5976328100)): B-360-1. Closed below.
- Opus APPROVE 0/0/2 ([issuecomment-5976279445](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/360#issuecomment-5976279445)): C-360-1 (late samples older than the overlap) and C-360-2 (all-or-nothing import pass). Design follow-ups, not in this round; they go to the post-landing follow-up PR the Opus verdict recommends (before the clinic Android build). Operator item 5 of the Opus lens report (closed error class in this catch) is the same seam as B-360-1 and is closed here.

### Finding -> change -> commit -> test
| Finding | Change | Commit | Test (fails before, passes after) |
|---|---|---|---|
| B-360-1 (a) native error text logged | `healthConnectSyncService.ts`: the rejected-page log carries `{ recordType, resumed, error: healthConnectReadErrorClass(err) }`. New closed union `HealthConnectReadErrorClass` = permission, service_unavailable, io, sdk_version, invalid_request, unknown, from a fixed `Map` of the react-native-health-connect 3.5.3 rejection codes (`ExceptionsUtils.kt`; PERMISSION_ERROR, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, CLIENT_NOT_INITIALIZED, UNDERLYING_ERROR, IO_EXCEPTION, SDK_VERSION_ERROR, ARGUMENT_VALIDATION_ERROR, INVALID_RECORD_TYPE). The code is only compared, never copied; `__proto__`/`constructor`, non-objects, non-string codes and a throwing getter give `unknown`; the classifier never throws. | `fde1875` | `healthConnectSyncService.test.ts` "B-360-1 ..." `it.each` x6 on the real paged client and real fence: Error with native text, PERMISSION_ERROR, IO_EXCEPTION, code outside the allow-list, non-Error rejection, throwing `code` getter. Each asserts the failed type, that the next type is still read, the exact class, and that no logger call contains the `AUDIT_360_PRIVATE_WEIGHT_81_6_KG` canary. Plus the classifier table (11 codes + 5 non-object shapes). |
| B-360-1 (b) logging after the fence retired | Rejected-page catch: `fence.throwIfStopped()` is the first statement (synchronous, same tick as the rejection handler), then the stop rethrow, then the unchanged per-type degrade (failed type keeps its progress; a failed resume drops its token). A page that rejects after sign-out start, an account switch or a cancelled Connect ends the run with `OnDeviceSessionChangedError`: nothing classified, recorded, sent, saved or logged. | `fde1875` | `it.each` x3: sign-out start / account switch / cancelled Connect while the page is in flight, then it rejects. Asserts the stop reason (`session_changed` / `cancelled`), one native call, no ingest, empty progress, no `logger.error`, no canary anywhere in the logger. |
| B-360-1 sibling: grant read | After `await client.getGrantedPermissions()` the fence is checked before the all-denied warn/throw, so a grant read that resolves after sign-out started stops the run instead of logging and reporting "permission denied". | `fde1875` | "a grant read that resolves after sign-out started reports and logs nothing". |
| B-360-1 same seam on HealthKit | `onDeviceConnect.ts` `connectHealthKit` catch: `if (!isCurrent()) return 'stopped'` before the message classification (before: `error`/`unsupported`, so the sheet showed Try again instead of the session-changed copy). It never logged; the message is still only regex-classified into the closed outcome. `healthKitSyncService.ts` has no logger call: a `requestAuth` rejection propagates, the client's per-metric settle catch logs nothing, and the service runs `throwIfStopped()` right after the read; no change needed. | `fde1875` | `onDeviceConnect.test.ts` "B-360-1: Apple Health: a permission-screen failure after the attempt ended is a stop, not an error". |
| Control | none | — | "control: an unchanged session with empty reads completes and logs no failure"; all existing pagination / resume / partial-read / B-317-7 cases unchanged and passing. |

Other catches in this piece were re-read and need no change: `healthConnectClient.ts` readAllSupportedRecords catch (no log, no sync-path caller), `healthKitClient.ts` settle catch (no log), `onDeviceConnect.ts` outer catch (already `isCurrent() ? 'error' : 'stopped'`) and the open-settings/store catches (no log). `ingestBatching.ts` (#359, dual-approved) is unchanged.

### Evidence
- Sol's failing probe at exact 4a508d8b: [run 37175348201](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175348201/job/111356709877) (2 failed / 1 passed).
- Failing-before, test commit `d605452` only + lane files (`0bcf80c7`): [run 37175837840](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175837840) = FAILURE, 12 failed / 41 passed; every failure is a B-360-1 case (logger received the canary text; logged after sign-out, account switch and cancel; grant-read warn after sign-out; classifier missing; HealthKit attempt-ended returned `error`).
- After, fix commit `fde1875` + lane files (`004f6b0a`): [run 37175851194](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37175851194) = SUCCESS, 2 suites / 53 tests.
- PR CI at this exact head: Typecheck, lint, test = SUCCESS, [run 37179701360](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37179701360/job/111369586215): tsc, eslint, jest 449 suites / 6,355 tests (6,342 + 13 new). Analyze (javascript-typescript) and Analyze (actions) run only on main-based PRs (`codeql.yml` `pull_request: branches: [main]`), so they do not run on this stacked head; they run when the stack lands through #359.

### Pre-push checklist
(a) the only log on this path carries record type, a boolean and a closed class; no message, name, raw code or sample data. (b) every await in the changed seams is followed by a fence check before any state write or log (page rejection, grant read, HealthKit permission screen). (c) sign-out, account switch and cancel during the in-flight page are covered by tests. (d) no user-facing copy changed. (e) failing-before run cited above. (f) size: 24 files, +1,844/-968 = 2,812 changed (source +806/-482, tests +1,038/-486), under 3,000.

### Stack
Merge-only restack pushed under the `wear` lock: #361 `574b32a8`, #362 `439937c9`, #363 `38ea0f81`, #364 `a3206441`; each piece's own diff has the same patch-id as before, and `git diff d0407b62 a3206441` (#317 head vs new top) = the clinic `easUpdateGuard` pin already at #364 + these 4 files only. Land as one (rule 11); no build or OTA from an intermediate piece.

READY FOR AUDIT
